- ENGLISH ROSE DESIGN QUILTED THROW led TW at £4,577.17, up 590.6% WoW from £662.74 LW, on 179 units TW versus 26 units LW across 5 orders in both weeks.
- The top three products (ENGLISH ROSE DESIGN QUILTED THROW, REGENCY CAKESTAND 3 TIER, WHITE HANGING HEART T-LIGHT HOLDER) held 38.3% combined share of the £25,571.27 TW revenue across the 20 rows shown.
- REGENCY CAKESTAND 3 TIER ranked 2 at £2,799.04 TW versus £3,107.77 LW, a WoW change of -9.9%, while units rose to 230 TW from 187 LW and orders fell to 40 TW from 44 LW.
- WHITE HANGING HEART T-LIGHT HOLDER posted £2,420.03 TW against £3,036.12 LW, -20.3% WoW, with units nearly flat at 909 TW versus 900 LW.
- CAMOFLAGE DESIGN TEDDY showed the largest WoW gain at 6,340.5% (£811.50 TW versus £12.60 LW), followed by MAGNETS PACK OF 4 VINTAGE COLLAGE at 4,954.6% (£821.37 TW versus £16.25 LW).
- BLUE HAPPY BIRTHDAY BUNTING fell 59.4% WoW to £771.52 and PINK HAPPY BIRTHDAY BUNTING fell 61.5% WoW to £760.50, a combined £1,532.02 TW versus £3,872.72 LW.
- BLUE CUSHION COVER WITH FLOWER (£958.95 TW, 2 orders) and BALLOON PUMP WITH 10 BALLOONS (£742.05 TW, 8 orders) recorded £0.00 LW, so no WoW percentage is calculable.
- PACK OF 72 RETRO SPOT CAKE CASES moved the most units at 1,724 TW versus 559 LW, with revenue of £764.96 TW, +92.9% WoW, ranking 16 of 20; LY revenue is blank for all 20 rows, so no YoY figures are available for 2010-W14.
